menu.title: Recover the Bluetooth link
menu.description:
{name} is currently: {link_state}.

The BedJet accepts one Bluetooth connection at a time and streams its status about four times a second for as long as a real link is held, so a device this quiet is not merely idle: either nothing is connected to it, or a proxy is still holding its single connection slot with a link that no longer carries anything. Because the slot looks occupied, the BedJet stops advertising and nothing else can get in.

Work down the list - each step is more disruptive than the one above it, and each one re-checks the link before bringing you back here.

{last_result}

menu_options.recheck: Check the link again (does nothing else)
menu_options.reload: Reload the integration (reconnects; nothing else is affected)
menu_options.restart_proxy: Restart the Bluetooth proxy that last held the link
menu_options.power_cycle: Cut and restore mains power to the BedJet (last resort)

power_cycle.title: Power-cycle {name}
power_cycle.description:
This switches an outlet off, waits ten seconds, and switches it back on. It cuts mains power to {name}: any running program stops, and the BedJet needs a moment to boot and start advertising again before anything can connect. Only do this once reloading and restarting the proxy have both failed.

Pick the switch that actually feeds this BedJet. The choice is remembered, so you will not be asked again.

data_description.entity_id: The switch that controls mains power to this BedJet.
